Lab 05 — Design Thinking Pack (D8): the walkthrough

This page shows every step of the lab with its minutes, its “Done when” check and, where it helps, an animation recorded from the Class 10 example programs. The full text of the lab, the template and the conditions are separate documents.

Ponderation 1-2-1: 120 min Studio + 60 min homeTeam of four · PO member 4 · SM member 1Feedback: Sun Nov 29, 23:59Final: Sun Dec 20, 23:59

Tools are open. Paper, a spreadsheet, any whiteboard or prototyping tool — or one you build yourselves. Every tool and technique on this page can be replaced by another suitable one. Research your options, be creative, and name what you used in the footer of your page.

A0
STUDIO · 10 MIN

Sprint 3 Planning → Box 7

  1. The PO (member 4) proposes a learning goal for Sprint 3 (Nov 23 → Dec 6).
  2. Check your Lab 04 flow policy: keep it or change it, in one sentence.
  3. Write the goal, the forecast and the policy line in Box 7.

Done when: The goal can be checked on Dec 6 with a yes or a no.

A1
STUDIO · 15 MIN

Box 1 · Five-mode plan

  1. Draw the Double Diamond and place Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test.
  2. One line per mode: output · date · owner.
  3. Draw the loop Test → Ideate and write its trigger.

Done when: Five outputs (not activities), five dates, five owners, one trigger.

A2
STUDIO · 20 MIN

Box 2 · Interview kit

  1. Describe the five interviewees as a group — no names.
  2. Write ten draft questions; label each open, closed, leading or hypothetical; keep eight open ones.
  3. Add three probes and the three-line consent script.

Done when: No question can be answered with yes or no; the script says what you will not ask.

A3
STUDIO · 30 MIN

Box 3 · First insight

  1. Two proxy interviews of six minutes each; one note per sticky note.
  2. Sort the notes into Says · Thinks · Does · Feels; mark one contradiction.
  3. Group and count themes; write one POV and three HMW questions.

Done when: Every quadrant has two notes or more; the POV's need is a verb.

A4
STUDIO · 15 MIN

Box 4 · First ideas

  1. Crazy 8s on the chosen HMW: eight sketches in eight minutes each.
  2. Star two sketches each; three silent dots each.
  3. Score impact and feasibility 1–5, place the ideas on the grid, choose one concept with five screens.

Done when: Scores are visible and the concept follows from the grid.

A5
STUDIO · 15 MIN

Box 6 · Mini-case (Hotel Mirador)

  1. Read the one-page case alone (5 min).
  2. Write five lines together: situation · problem · alternatives · recommendation · consequences.

Done when: Two case numbers in the situation, one in the consequences, three alternatives or more.

A6
STUDIO · 10 MIN

Sprint Review rehearsal

  1. The presenter shows Boxes 1–4 and 6 in four minutes.
  2. Write the best question and your answer in the footer.

Done when: The page is shown, not read aloud.

A7
STUDIO · 5 MIN

Retrospective → Box 7

  1. Three notes: what helped, what slowed you down, one change for Studio 1.

Done when: Each note describes something observable.

B1
HOME · 15 MIN

Box 5 · Test plan and studio roles

  1. Three tasks written as goals; the think-aloud instruction; severity 1–4; the loop rule.
  2. A 3 × 4 roles table for Studio 1–3 without repeated roles.

Done when: Tasks give goals, not steps; nobody repeats a role.

B2
HOME · 20 MIN

Box 7 · First real interview

  1. One interview of at most ten minutes with your kit, consent script first.
  2. Type up to six paraphrased notes the same day; destroy the handwritten ones.
  3. One sentence: what it confirmed or contradicted.

Done when: No name or detail that identifies the person.

B3
HOME · 15 MIN

Checks and one cold read

  1. Run every “Done when” check.
  2. A member who did not write a box reads the page cold; fix only what they stumbled on.

Done when: Every box passes its check.

B4
HOME · 10 MIN

Export, name, submit

  1. One PDF, at most four pages: DIG123_D8_<TeamName>_<date>.pdf.
  2. Each member uploads it with their own five-line Learning Log.

Done when: Uploaded by every member before Sun Nov 29, 23:59 (feedback date).

🔒 Interviews with real people — the rules

  • Adults only; never team members for the real interviews. Your university's rules on research with people apply first.
  • Read the three-line consent script first; stop if the person hesitates.
  • Collect only what the design question needs (GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation), Art. 5(1)(c)). Allergies are health data (Art. 9): ask how people choose and check food, never why they avoid something.
  • No names, contacts, recordings or photographs of people. Paraphrased insights only; handwritten notes destroyed the same day; typed notes deleted after Dec 20.
